stem: The earliest clinical stage of pertussis is described as most similar to which everyday illness pattern?

options.label: A
options.text: Only sudden flaccid paralysis after poliovirus illness
options.misconception: Neuro distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong pattern; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: Immediate anaphylaxis after an isolated bee sting
options.misconception: Allergy distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong pattern; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Only overnight progression into diabetic ketoacidosis
options.explanation: Wrong pattern; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: Only acute crushing pain of myocardial infarction
options.misconception: Cardio distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong pattern; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Insidious onset resembling a common cold stage
options.explanation: CDC: catarrhal stage similar to common cold.

context: Learning objective: recall pertussis, catarrhal from the cited FOSS source.
